description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterObject, which implements a method to unregister objects within the Smarty templating engine. The class includes a property for object mapping and a method to handle object unregistration by manipulating the Smarty registered objects array.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterObject
classes.description: Class providing a method to unregister objects from Smarty's internal registry.

methods.name: unregisterObject
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered object in Smarty by removing it from the registered objects array.
